summary: Haleon plc filed a Form 6-K reporting transactions in its own shares under an ongoing buyback programme announced 12 March 2026. Between 10-14 August 2026, it repurchased 10,995,213 ordinary shares at prices ranging from 355.8p to 367.0p per share, for cancellation. Following settlement, registered share capital is 8,809,911,209 shares, with 11,807,443 held in treasury and 8,798,103,766 voting shares. The buyback reduces share count, returning capital to shareholders. Watch for programme progress and impact on EPS and share price support.
